newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba, RWE agree telecom name - paper.
newsitem.headline: Veba, RWE agree telecom name - paper.

text.p: German utilities Veba AG and RWE AG agreed on a name for their telecommunications venture amid speculation British partner Cable & Wireless Plc would pull out of the deal, a Berlin newspaper reported on Monday.
The two companies confirmed they would call the venture "Otelo," the Berliner Zeitung said.
Veba and C&W formed an alliance in 1995 and last year agreed to bring RWE on board last year. But C&W now wanted to back out of the venture, London papers reported over the weekend.

Berliner Zeitung also said Veba was negotiating with Deutsche Telekom AG to end its complaint to the European Union about the German phone company's business phone rates. Veba would drop the complaint if Telekom agreed to lower rates Veba pays for connecting to the Telekom network.
Veba's complaint has been suspended until March 31, the paper said.
